description: Find synergy categories and sample cards that work well with a specific card. Use this when a user wants to know what strategies or card types synergize with a particular card. Identifies matching archetypes (tokens, sacrifice, counters, etc.) and suggests complementary cards.

card_name.description: Card name to find synergies for

category.description: Filter by specific synergy category ID

color_identity.description: Filter synergistic cards within this color identity

limit.description: Max sample cards per category (default 5, max 50)

name: find_synergies
